title: Source
description: A supply source. Two kinds only (spec §3). 'Relay stations' are api_key sources with a custom base_url, never a third kind.

vendor.description: Standard vendor id (anthropic|openai|zhipuai|kimi|xai|...) or 'custom'. Also the OpenCode provider prefix (see opencode-overlay.md).

base_url.description: api_key kind only. null = vendor official default. Custom value covers relays/self-hosted gateways.

supply_channel.description: Resolved 2026-07-23 (README): subscription→native_cli by default (sanctioned CLI-held OAuth, per-turn dispatch), api_key→hub. Any hub-held subscription (Claude AND ChatGPT) requires the subscription_hub_experimental flag + recorded per-source consent; UI marks such sources 实验.

experimental_consent_at.description: Set iff this is a hub-held subscription the user explicitly consented to (subscription_hub_experimental). null otherwise.

status.description: Classified by whether the state heals itself (spec §4.5). active = 使用中; standby = 备用 (healthy, not at the head of some agent's order); cooldown = 暂不可用, self-healing, `retry_at` known; needs_action = 需处理, will NEVER recover unattended (v2, 2026-07-29); error = unclassified. Ordering is per-agent but health is source-global: quota and reachability are properties of the account, so one cooldown pool is shared across backends (core/handlers/model_hub/service.py::_cooldown). NOTE: `needs_action` is a v2 TARGET value — config/v2_config.py's loader whitelist still rejects it until the serializer PR lands it.

retry_at.description: When a cooldown lapses. Always null for needs_action — nothing to wait for.

detail_key.description: i18n key, never raw upstream error text. For needs_action it names the cause so the row can offer one tap to fix it: models.source.needs_action.oauth_expired (re-auth), .balance_exhausted (top up), .credential_revoked (replace key), .account_banned (contact vendor).

currency.description: ISO 4217. Default and product standard is USD (owner ruling 2026-07-25): upstream vendors bill in USD, so UI must never fall back to a local currency. Other codes are honored only when the backend explicitly reports them.

projected_exhaust_at.description: v2 (2026-07-29), subscription sources only: linear projection of when the cycle quota runs out, from recent usage. Drives the sub-line 「按近 7 天用量,预计周三用完」. PHASED DELIBERATELY — the contract is frozen in v2, the projection itself may land later, and null MUST render as simply absent (never 0, never '未知'). Frozen here so the field never has to be retrofitted through the serializer completeness guard twice.

credential_ref.description: Opaque handle. Secret material NEVER appears in any payload (README invariant 1). null for native_cli sources (credential lives in the CLI's own store).

account_label.description: v1.1 (07-23 12:10, L4 finding): human display identity for subscription sources (e.g. 'me@gmail.com'), for the row's mono sub-line (frame 01r). Populated from the sanctioned CLI auth surface for native_cli sources; MAY stay null for hub-held experimental sources until a later adapter rev. Never secret material.

masked_credential.description: v1.1 (07-23 12:10, L4 finding): non-reversible display mask for api_key sources, computed by L2 ONCE at provisioning from the transient secret (rule: ≤7-char prefix + '…' + last 4, e.g. 'sk-ant-…8f2A') and persisted as display data only. Never re-derivable, never secret material.
